concern: safe_path accepts the normalized relative directory token dot.
assessment: No concrete defect in current fixed publication artifact or stated file-inventory contract. Fixed selected paths, literal pinned originals and closed sealed path lists contain no dot member. The consumer inventories actual regular files, which cannot have basename dot; a manifest dot entry fails inventory equality. This helper alone is not a universal regular-file-name classifier.
decision: Document boundary; no speculative API expansion or repair required.
